create_scene: create the global scene for the daycare substrate environment
build_child_objects: build child avatar objects for a given player index in the daycare substrate
build_parent_objects: build parent avatar objects for a given player index in the daycare substrate
create_avatar_objects: create avatar objects for a sequence of player roles such as child or parent
get_config: get the default configuration for the daycare substrate including action sets and observation specs
build: build the daycare substrate definition given player roles and a config dictionary
